spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Terminal-adjacent, grid-based, highly structured. Zero unnecessary padding, optical alignment for technical interfaces.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C4F159] text-black font-semibold rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-[#D9F99D] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C4F159]/50 focus:outline-none
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-zinc-700 transition-colors border border-zinc-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-600 focus:outline-none
buttons.ghost: bg-transparent text-zinc-300 font-medium rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white transition-colors
buttons.icon_button: p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors

inputs.search: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white placeholder-zinc-500 focus:border-[#C4F159] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C4F159] transition-all
inputs.editor_textarea: w-full h-full bg-transparent border-none resize-none text-[#FFFFFF] font-['JetBrains_Mono'] focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none placeholder-zinc-600

cards.default: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-4 hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors

tags.default: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 text-xs font-medium border border-zinc-700

dropdowns.trigger: flex items-center gap-2 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm hover:border-zinc-700
dropdowns.menu: bg-[#0F0F11] border border-zinc-800 rounded-md shadow-xl overflow-hidden

login_background.description: Minimal dark architecture towers for login background overlay

app_layout.structure: 100vh flex layout. Left sidebar (fixed), Right main content (flex-1 flex col).
app_layout.sidebar: bg-[#0F0F11] border-r border-zinc-800 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar. Contains logo, Search, Tabs (Prompts, Patterns, History).

toolbar.structure: H-14 border-b border-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-between px-6 bg-[#050505]
toolbar.right: Optimize button (Primary Volt Lime), Fork button, Save button, Copy button

editor_split_pane.left_pane: flex-1 p-6 relative group. Raw notes input area.
editor_split_pane.right_pane: flex-1 p-6 overflow-y-auto relative bg-[#050505]. Optimized output rendered as formatted markdown/code.

accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C4F159]/50` for primary, `focus:ring-zinc-600` for dark elements).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors are `#FFFFFF` and `#A1A1AA` on `#050505` and `#0F0F11` backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All key elements must include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='optimize-button'`, `data-testid='pattern-selector'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for layout structure (flexbox, grid) instead of heavy layout components to maintain the snappy, editor-first feel.
Implement Shadcn UI for Dialogs, Select/Dropdowns, Tooltips, and ScrollAreas, customizing them heavily with the provided color tokens (border-zinc-800, bg-[#0F0F11]).
The Optimize button is the primary CTA and should use the highly visible Volt Lime (#C4F159).
Ensure the split pane allows horizontal scrolling or wrapping if needed, but primarily it should be flex-1 / flex-1 equal split.
For the code editor inputs and outputs, apply the 'JetBrains Mono' font explicitly.
